title: EchoFocus-CHD detects congenital heart disease lesions from echocardiography
summary: EchoFocus-CHD, a transformer-based multitask model built on the PanEcho architecture, was trained to detect 12 critical and 8 noncritical congenital heart lesions from echocardiograms. The internal cohort had 54,727 echos (3.4 million videos) from Boston Children's Hospital, and a referral cohort had 3356 echos from external US and international centers. The abstract text available here is truncated before the performance figures, so no AUC values are reported; the work is retrospective.
ai_technology: EchoFocus-CHD, a multitask view-agnostic transformer model (extending PanEcho) for echocardiography
organization: Boston Children’s Hospital; Harvard Medical School

evidence.tested: Internally trained (80%) and tested (20%) on Boston Children's Hospital echos and evaluated on an external referral cohort.
evidence.unknown: Performance figures were not visible in the abstract text reviewed; prospective effect on triage; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Detects critical and noncritical congenital heart lesions from echo videos.
